content: Task-Specific Output Heads: Task-specific output modules map representations from sentence encoders to outputs specific to a task, e.g. entailment/neutral/contradiction for NLI tasks, or tags for part-of-speech tagging. They also include logic for computing the corresponding loss for training (e.g. cross-entropy).
